description: This file defines the SoftGateKeeper class, which implements cryptographic operations and failure record management for a gatekeeper system, including password hashing, signature computation, and failure record handling.

classes.name: gatekeeper::SoftGateKeeper
classes.description: A class implementing cryptographic and failure record management functionalities for gatekeeper.

classes.name: gatekeeper::fast_hash_t
classes.description: A structure representing a fast hash with a salt and digest.

methods.name: ComputePasswordSignature
methods.description: Computes a password signature using scrypt.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Fills a buffer with pseudo-random bytes.

methods.name: ComputeSignature
methods.description: Computes a signature, here it just zeroes the buffer.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Indicates whether hardware-backed security is used.

methods.name: GetFailureRecord
methods.description: Retrieves failure record for a user.

methods.name: ClearFailureRecord
methods.description: Clears failure record for a user.

methods.name: WriteFailureRecord
methods.description: Stores a failure record for a user.

methods.name: ComputeFastHash
methods.description: Computes a fast hash combining a password and salt.

methods.name: VerifyFast
methods.description: Verifies a fast hash against a password.

methods.name: DoVerify
methods.description: Verifies a password handle against a password, updating fast hash map if needed.
